# Error #76: GovernanceAlreadyExecuted

## Summary
- **Numeric Code**: `#76`

- **Status**: Active (Enforced)
- **Client Toast Level**: `ERROR`

---

## Trigger Conditions
The contract rejects the call when any of these registry conditions holds:
- `Branch::GovernanceAlreadyExecuted` — the proposal has already been executed.

---

## Minimal Reproduction

Focused regression test: [`contracts/streaming-payments/src/governance_test.rs::executing_a_consumed_proposal_is_refused`](../../contracts/streaming-payments/src/governance_test.rs::executing_a_consumed_proposal_is_refused). The matrix arm below is the smallest direct construction; `rejected!` records the fired branch and asserts its mapped code.

```rust
// GovernanceAlreadyExecuted — excerpt from error_surface_test.rs
let g = Governed::new();
let id = g.propose_fee(&g.a, 100);
g.f.client.mock_all_auths().governance_sign(&g.a, &id);
g.f.client.mock_all_auths().governance_sign(&g.b, &id);
g.mature();
let executor = Address::generate(&g.f.env);
g.f.client
    .mock_all_auths()
    .governance_execute(&executor, &id);
Some(rejected!(g
    .f
    .client
    .mock_all_auths()
    .try_governance_execute(&executor, &id)))
```

Run the focused test:

```bash
cargo test -p streampay-contract --locked executing_a_consumed_proposal_is_refused
```

## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Create a new proposal for a fresh action; an executed proposal id is consumed and cannot be replayed.
>
> **Reference**: [`docs/POLICY_GOVERNANCE.md#1-governance-model`](../../docs/POLICY_GOVERNANCE.md#1-governance-model)
